title: Is your blood blue inside you? Total myth 🩸
description:
Your blood is never blue: it's bright red with oxygen and dark red without. Veins only look blue because of how light travels through skin.

Sources: The Naked Scientists, 'Mythconception: Venous blood is blue'; Science ABC, 'If blood is red, why do veins appear blue?'; Kienle et al. 1996, 'Why do veins appear blue? A new look at an old question'; Discover Wildlife on horseshoe crab blood.

scenes.say: Your blood is *blue* until it hits the air? Total myth.

You, though? *Red*. All the way through.
